description: This source file defines the DeepLinks handling logic for the macOS app, including URL parsing, validation, and agent invocation via deep links. It contains the DeepLinkHandler class, validation policies, and related enums and utility functions.

classes.name: DeepLinkHandler
classes.description: Manages the processing of incoming deep links, validation, user prompts, and invocation of agent actions.

methods.name: handle(url:)
methods.description: Asynchronously handles a URL by parsing it, validating, and executing corresponding agent commands.

methods.name: handleAgent(link:originalURL:)
methods.description: Processes an agent deep link, validates message size, prompts the user if necessary, and sends the agent command.

methods.name: currentKey()
methods.description: Returns the current security key used for deep link validation.

methods.name: currentCanvasKey()
methods.description: Returns the ephemeral key used for unattended deep links from the Canvas.

methods.name: expectedKey()
methods.description: Retrieves or generates the key stored in user defaults for deep link validation.

methods.name: generateRandomKey()
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random key for deep link validation.

methods.name: confirm(title:message:)
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog to the user and returns true if confirmed.

methods.name: presentAlert(title:message:)
methods.description: Displays an alert dialog with the specified title and message.

methods.name: validateMessageForHandle
methods.description: Validates whether a message fits security constraints before processing.

methods.name: effectiveDelivery
methods.description: Determines delivery permissions and routing for deep links.
